scope: Reference-specific map for the corrected AthenaK nonlinear Bell campaign against only the Bell normalization and analytic benchmark retained in Sun and Bai (2023) and Bai et al. (2015). This successor additionally binds the exact Bai et al. charge-fraction and CR-Hall definitions used by the Q019 applicability accounting. The retained target-paper Bell benchmark is linear; no standalone nonlinear-saturation dataset or numerical acceptance tolerance is inferred from it.
matched_equations: Sun and Bai Section 5.2 Equation (27) supplies the Bell dispersion relation and defines k0=j_CR/(2*B_g*c); AthenaK raw prtcl_j is J_CR/c, so the target deposited current is 2*B0*k0.
Sun and Bai Section 5.2 states that the most unstable wavenumber is k=k0 and that the unstable mode is right-polarized.
Sun and Bai Section 2.2 Equations (3)-(6) use ideal-MHD induction and conservative CR-to-gas momentum and energy source terms, matching the corrected AthenaK no-Hall paper-MHD-PIC carrier scope.
Bai et al. Equation (10) defines R=n_CR/(n_i+n_CR), using charge densities, and states that the MHD-PIC formulation requires R much less than 1.
Bai et al. Equation (12) defines Lambda=R*(u_CR-v_g)/v_A as the CR-Hall importance parameter.

Bai et al. Section 4 Equations (29)-(31) define f=1+(Lambda/2)^2, k_m=k0/f, and growth-rate factor 1/sqrt(f) in the R much less than 1 limit, reducing to the no-Hall Bell relation when the CR-Hall contribution is removed and f=1.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: k0=j_CR/(2*B_g*c), epsilon=U_A/v_CR, with the most unstable wavenumber k=k0.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: raw prtcl_j is J_CR/c; therefore volume_average(prtcl_j_parallel)=2*B0*k0.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: The initialized most-unstable eigenmode is right-polarized and relates transverse gas velocity and magnetic perturbations.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: The corrected Q023 linear predecessor must establish phase and right-handed polarization before Q019 nonlinear execution.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: The gas follows ideal MHD with CR momentum and energy feedback and cE=-u cross B.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: Q019 corrected branches use the no-Hall ideal-MHD carrier with full CR momentum and energy feedback.

provenance_entries.section: 4. Linear analysis of the Bell instability
provenance_entries.reference_statement: The Hall-modified dispersion defines k0=J_CR/(2*B0), f=1+(Lambda/2)^2, and reduces to the standard fixed-current Bell relation when the CR-Hall term is absent.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: The corrected Q019 target-paper comparison is restricted to the no-Hall limit; Hall-modified growth and saturation are excluded.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: R=n_CR/|n_e|=n_CR/(n_i+n_CR), where the symbols are charge densities, and the formulation requires R much less than 1.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: Q019 computes the charge-density ratio from the explicitly bound deposited CR charge density and similarity-scaled background-ion charge-to-mass ratio; no numeric much-less-than acceptance threshold is inferred.

provenance_entries.reference_statement: Lambda=R*(u_CR-v_g)/v_A and the CR-Hall term becomes dynamically important as Lambda approaches unity.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: Q019 evaluates Lambda from the deposited current, local relative drift normalization, and mapped background charge density while retaining review-pending applicability status.

provenance_entries.section: 4. Linear analysis of the Bell instability
provenance_entries.reference_statement: The text motivates strongly nonlinear upstream evolution and magnetic amplification in shock precursors.
provenance_entries.athenak_mapping: This motivates nonlinear continuation but does not supply a standalone periodic-box saturation target or tolerance.

intentional_mismatches: The corrected AthenaK Q019 comparison is no-Hall; Hall-modified growth and saturation in Bai et al. are not matched.

The high-rigidity AthenaK branch advances CR particles and may be labeled fixed-current-like only after its current and momentum invariance gates pass; it is not an exactly locked external-current experiment.
The finite-rigidity AthenaK branch is a separately named self-consistent periodic-box analogue and is not identified with the target-paper linear Bell benchmark.
The target-paper Bell benchmark is linear and supplies no standalone nonlinear saturation history, saturation amplitude, morphology dataset, or nonlinear parameter grid.
